name: Virgin Records
founders: Richard Branson, Simon Draper, Nik Powell
ownershipStory: Started as a mail-order record business before becoming a label, Virgin grew into one of the UK's major independents and signed Public Image Ltd directly out of the collapse of the Sex Pistols. Branson sold the label's recorded-music arm to Thorn EMI in 1992.
hook: The independent that signed John Lydon the moment the Sex Pistols were finished.

blurb.age7: This record company started as a tiny record shop and grew huge.
blurb.age13: Virgin Records started as a small mail-order record shop before it became one of Britain's biggest independent labels. It signed Public Image Ltd right after the Sex Pistols broke up.
blurb.adult: Virgin's growth from mail-order business to major independent is a useful contrast to Trax or the Kingston sound systems: a UK label that scaled up enough to eventually be sold to a major, Thorn EMI, in 1992.
